summary: Generated visual assets now use visual-asset-manifest/v2 and fail closed at accepted/integrated unless versioned generator, generation_run_id, and candidate_id evidence matches the preserved Codex image_gen output path. The World Cup Hub integrated hero was migrated only from its real Codex generation event, original PNG path, candidate id, and verified original/derivative hashes.
decisions: Bump new generated-asset manifests to visual-asset-manifest/v2 while retaining v1 only for planned or sourced compatibility; a v1 generated accepted/integrated record is a hard error.
Use visual-asset-generation-provenance/v1 with per-asset generator, generation_run_id, and candidate_id fields. Planned records carry null placeholders; final generated records require real values.

Derive run and candidate identity from the exact $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/<generation-run-id>/<candidate-id>.png path and require the registration session id to match, so arbitrary caller strings cannot establish provenance.

Keep cli.py and production_verifier.py unchanged. Existing registration arguments remain compatible because the registry derives the new fields instead of accepting new user-authored provenance arguments.

Migrate the World Cup Hub hero with generation run 019e2de5-941b-7971-98e3-6ed84372f36b and candidate ig_05e8553d24da513b016a07d77edabc8191bf7569ff5368de06 only after matching its image_generation_end event and both verified hashes.
